currentTask.title: M2 responsive Pass-around board, stable paging and Focus editor/roster

requirements.text: Implement an upright Pass-around board with two columns. Auto uses four visible seats when 240px-wide, 168px-high minimum panels and required controls fit (including text scaling); otherwise use two seats or Focus. Four players fit a 2x2 board at 844x390 with normal text; short landscape may fall back. Keep minus left/plus right, 48px targets and inward name/tracker bands using matching DOM order.

For larger tables use stable contiguous seat groups of two or four with visible Previous/Next, page count and seat range. Grouping does not change due to values or selection. On density/viewport changes retain the page containing the previous anchor seat. No counters, IDs or seat order reset through paging or resizing.

Portrait/narrow screens or explicit Focus show one full player editor and a roster for all players. Selecting a roster button updates only editor selection, retains keyboard focus on the roster button, exposes Selected text and aria-pressed, and announces the selected player and values. Provide an explicit Adjust Player N link that scrolls/focuses the editor without changing values.

Expose only implemented Pass-around/Tabletop/Focus and Auto/2/4 density choices in a labeled native modal Table menu opened by a circular existing-app-icon button. Escape/Done return trigger focus and modal blocks background edits. Four-seat board places menu in the local meeting-corner pocket with no full-width menu strip or life hit region behind it; Focus/two-seat layouts use an inline menu row. Preserve requested preferences during automatic fallback and describe fallback.

Preserve 2-12 setup, stable IDs/seats, initial40/0, negative life, poison floor, queued updates and player isolation. Presentation preferences are session-local and selection is not turn order. Layout/selection/menu actions never mutate game values.

Use shared typed React components and Storybook states for board, paging, Focus, roster and menu. Preserve existing behavioral assertions by adapting navigation; add pure layout, component and real-browser coverage for representative2/4/6/12 tables, 844x390,736x360,390x844,320x568, enlarged text, page boundaries, focus return and state preservation.

nonGoals: Tabletop rotation was subsequently authorized and reviewed separately; no additional Tabletop features, six-visible density, quick life zones, undo, gestures, persistence, network sync, generic tracking, player management or counts above twelve.
No dependency additions or audit-policy/threshold changes. No physical-device or screen-reader validation claim.
